Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert incorrectly stated that the American version of Survivor has 46 unique winners up to the end of the 44th season. This is an error because Survivor has had multiple repeat winners (e.g., Sandra Diaz-Twine and Tony Vlachos), meaning the number of unique winners would be less than the total number of seasons. The WebServing_Expert did not account for repeat winners and simply equated the number of unique winners to the number of seasons, leading to an inflated count and ultimately an incorrect difference calculation.
